name: PPC Rejection and QC Report
query:
SELECT
  pa.posting_date AS `Date:Date:100`,
  pa.workstation AS `Workstation:Link/Workstation:160`,
  pi.source_job_card AS `Job Card:Link/Job Card Computer Paper:160`,
  pi.stage AS `Stage:Data:140`,
  pi.operator AS `Operator:Data:140`,
  pi.good_quantity AS `Good:Float:90`,
  pi.rejected_quantity AS `Rejected:Float:100`,
  pi.rejection_reason AS `Rejection Reason:Data:240`,
  pi.qc_status AS `QC:Data:90`,
  pi.qc_comments AS `QC Comments:Data:240`
FROM `tabPPC Production Actual` pa
INNER JOIN `tabPPC Production Actual Item` pi ON pi.parent = pa.name
WHERE pa.docstatus = 1
  AND (IFNULL(pi.rejected_quantity, 0) > 0 OR pi.qc_status IN ('Hold','Rejected'))
ORDER BY pa.posting_date DESC
